content: प्रसङ्गः .²1 Attachment, devotion, addiction, devotedness; स्वरूपयोग्ये सुरतप्रसङ्गे <ls>Ku. 1. 19</ls>; तस्यात्यायतकोमलस्य सततं द्यूतप्रसङ्गेन किम् <ls>Mk. 2. 11</ls>; <ls>Śi. 11. 22</ls>. .²2 Union, intercourse, association, connection; निवर्ततामस्माद्गणिकाप्रसंगात् <ls>Mk. 4</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 251</ls>. .²3 Illicit intercourse. .²4 Occupation, intentness, being engaged or occupied with; भ्रूविक्रियायां विरतप्रसङ्गैः <ls>Ku. 3. 47</ls>. .²5 A subject or topic (of discourse or controversy). .²6 An occasion, incident; दिग्विजयप्रसंगेन <ls>K. 191</ls>; यात्राप्रसंगेन <ls>Māl. 1</ls>. .²7 Conjuncture, time, opportunity; सूक्ष्मेभ्योऽपि प्रसंगेभ्यः स्त्रियो रक्ष्या विशेषतः <ls>Ms. 9. 5</ls>. .²8 A contingency, event, case, occurrence of a possibility; नेश्वरो जगतः कारणमुपपद्यते, कुतः, वैषम्यनैर्घृण्यप्रसंगात् <ls>Ś. B.</ls>; एवं चानवस्थाप्रसंगः {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%}; तस्याणुतरप्रसंगात् <ls>Tarka K.</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 16</ls>. .²8 Connected reasoning or argument. .²9 A conclusion, an inference. .²10 Connected language. .²11 Inseparable application or connection (= व्याप्ति <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²12 Mention of parents. .²13 Introduction, insertion. .²14 Gain. .²15 An extended application; अन्यत्र कृतस्यान्यत्रासक्तिः प्रसङ्गः . यथा प्रदीपस्य प्रासादे कृतस्य राजमार्गेऽप्यालोककरणम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 12. 1. 1</ls>. .²16 (In drama) A second or subsidiary incident or plot. .({@प्रसंगेन@}, {@प्रसंगतः, प्रसंगात्@} are used adverbially in the sense of:-- .²1 in relation to. .²2 in consequence of, on account of, because of, by way of. .²3 occasionally, incidentally. .²4 in course of; as in कथाप्रसंगेन ‘in course of conversation’).
